The '''TIE crawler''', also known as the '''century tank''' or '''TIE tank''', was a light armoured vehicle used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was an unlikely fusion of two vastly different vehicle types.

==Description==
[[File:TIEcrawler_schem.jpg|thumb|left|180px|[[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] crawler [[:Category:Technical drawing images|schematics]].]]

The TIE crawler resembled a [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] cockpit suspended between two massive tank treads. It could hold only a single person, who acted as [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]].

Driving the tank treads at speeds of up to 90 kilometers per hour<ref name="Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref> were twin [[Santhe/Sienar Technologies|Santhe]] [[SSct power generator]]s. The pilot used foot controls to adjust the angle of steering and speed, while the hand controls were tied into the fire control systems.

The tank had a pair of medium blaster cannons in the familiar "chin" mounts found on most TIE cockpits. Suspended below the cockpit ball was a retractable light turbolaser which provided the tank with considerable firepower.<ref name="Handbook" />

==History==
The plans for the century tank were developed first by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as early as [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], with the Imperial Army boasting that its capabilities were superior to that of the TIE/LN Starfighter. One unit notable for its use of century tanks was the [[71st Elite Mechanized Assault Group]].<ref name="Handbook" />

Although the century tank became famous after [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], an early version of the vehicle&mdash;the [[TIE ap-1]], or TIE Mauler&mdash;saw some action during the first years of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], where it fought against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

The century tank was the first new design to roll out of the newly liberated Santhe/Sienar Technologies in the uncertain times after the Battle of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. The independent-minded Santhe family, owners of [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]], had long bristled under the restrictive contracts of the Empire, and saw the opportunity of independence following the Empire's defeat.

[[File:Tiecrawler-recg.jpg|thumb|left|150px|A Century tank on patrol]]

Santhe tried to remain neutral in the drawn out fighting between the shrinking [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] and the growing [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. They still produced TIE fighters for Imperial [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]], but did so on their terms.

In an attempt to break into new markets, the century tank was conceived as a relatively inexpensive to produce and purchase compact assault vehicle (CAV). Its use of recycled components and designs helped cut costs and training time.

The tank was cheap and mass-produced and saw some action in the [[Imperial Civil War]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], as squabbling warlords sought to take control of the former Imperial capital prior to the reborn [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] reappearance.

During [[Second Battle of Coruscant]] century tank was used by the [[Dark Empire]].<ref name="Dark Empire">''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire]]''</ref> It was essential in the Dark Empire's efforts to retake the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="NEGVV">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>

At least one century tank was in service with the [[Corellian Security Force]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Exile" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TIEcrawler.jpg|thumb|180px|A TIE crawler on Coruscant in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]]]]

The ''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]'' capitalizes the first letter, spelling it "Century tank," whereas the [[Databank (original)|Databank]] uses all lower-case letters to spell the name.

In 2007, LEGO released a set based on the tank. Called a "TIE Crawler," the set comes with two [[Shadow stormtrooper/Legends|shadow stormtrooper]] figures. LEGO's TIE crawler also was equipped with two dual laser cannons that extended from the outside of the port and starboard tread hulls, giving this variant increased firepower over the standard tank. The century tank was the second only fully-[[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]] [[LEGO Star Wars|LEGO ''Star Wars'']] set to be released, the first being the [[TIE/D automated starfighter]], although the TIE/D was included in a set with two other in-universe TIE fighters and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]{{'s}} [[Darth Vader's TIE Advanced/Legends|TIE/Advanced starfighter]].
